inference_10.scope: Explicit corrected multi-airport inference graph for 10 active populations.

corrected_descriptions.finding: The active source feature list extends epoch time with departure-estimate, airline-category and taxi-to-gate feature families. A distinct weather-severity feature operation is not supported by this active construction.
corrected_descriptions.replacement: Build deterministic epoch-time, departure-estimate, saved airline-category and observation-available taxi-to-gate features, with explicit joins and training/query missing-value policies.

corrected_descriptions.finding: The intake groups regression before residual calculation, but source lower-model fitting depends on residual-based selection. The original five-stage linear structure cannot express both fits faithfully.
corrected_descriptions.replacement: Separate grouped internal regression, rounded residual selection and retained-population regression.
Fit strict-underestimation labels on all held-out rows using rounded training predictions; keep unrounded prediction features during query inference.
Estimate signed conditional median offsets on held-out rows, apply them only for strict probability branches, retain float32 arithmetic and final checked int32 rounding.
Use the explicit training-record/control to complete-model-state interface and saved-state/query-record to identity-aligned prediction-table interface.
